```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Core packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readr)
  library(janitor)
  library(scales)
})

# Optional/modeling packages. Install any missing packages before running those sections.
has_randomForest <- requireNamespace("randomForest", quietly = TRUE)
has_caret <- requireNamespace("caret", quietly = TRUE)
has_lpSolve <- requireNamespace("lpSolve", quietly = TRUE)
has_igraph <- requireNamespace("igraph", quietly = TRUE)
has_ggraph <- requireNamespace("ggraph", quietly = TRUE)
has_vip <- requireNamespace("vip", quietly = TRUE)

set.seed(42)
```

```{r paths-and-load-data}
# Change this path to the folder where your ReFED CSV files are stored.
DATA_DIR <- "C:/Users/argen/OneDrive/Desktop/data"

SUMMARY_FILE <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "ReFED_US_Food_Surplus_Summary.csv")
DETAIL_FILE  <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "ReFED_US_Food_Surplus_Detail.csv")
CAUSE_FILE   <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "ReFED_US_Food_Surplus_Cause_Summary.csv")

OUTPUT_DIR <- "refed_outputs"
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

load_refed_csv <- function(path) {
  # ReFED files include a first metadata line, so skip the first row.
  read_csv(path, skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    clean_names()
}

summary <- load_refed_csv(SUMMARY_FILE)
detail  <- load_refed_csv(DETAIL_FILE)
cause   <- load_refed_csv(CAUSE_FILE)
```

```{r inspect-data}
cat("Loaded datasets:\n")
cat("  Summary:", paste(dim(summary), collapse = " x "), "\n")

cat("  Cause  :", paste(dim(cause), collapse = " x "), "\n\n")

cat("Columns:\n")
cat("Summary:", paste(names(summary), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Detail :", paste(names(detail), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Cause  :", paste(names(cause), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r helper-functions}
save_plot <- function(filename, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, filename),
    plot = last_plot(),
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

normalize_series <- function(x) {
  denom <- max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(denom) || denom == 0) {
    return(rep(0, length(x)))
  }
  (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / denom
}

write_output_csv <- function(df, filename) {
  write_csv(df, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, filename))
}
```

```{r clean-data}
# Trim whitespace from character columns.
summary <- summary %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), str_trim))
detail  <- detail  %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), str_trim))
cause   <- cause   %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), str_trim))

# Keep the latest year if multiple years are present.
if ("year" %in% names(summary)) {
  summary <- summary %>% filter(year == max(year, na.rm = TRUE))
}
if ("year" %in% names(detail)) {
  detail <- detail %>% filter(year == max(year, na.rm = TRUE))
}
if ("year" %in% names(cause)) {
  cause <- cause %>% filter(year == max(year, na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

```{r policy-priority-score}
policy_df <- summary %>%
  group_by(sector) %>%
  summarise(
    tons_surplus = sum(tons_surplus, na.rm = TRUE),
    us_dollars_surplus = sum(us_dollars_surplus, na.rm = TRUE),
    surplus_total_100_year_mtco2e_footprint = sum(surplus_total_100_year_mtco2e_footprint, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

landfill_by_sector <- sector_destination %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    destination_total = sum(c_across(all_of(destination_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    landfill_share = if_else("tons_landfill" %in% destination_cols && destination_total > 0, tons_landfill / destination_total, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(sector, landfill_share)

policy_df <- policy_df %>%
  left_join(landfill_by_sector, by = "sector") %>%
  mutate(
    landfill_share = replace_na(landfill_share, 0),
    priority_score =
      0.35 * normalize_series(tons_surplus) +
      0.30 * normalize_series(surplus_total_100_year_mtco2e_footprint) +
      0.20 * normalize_series(us_dollars_surplus) +
      0.15 * normalize_series(landfill_share)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(priority_score))

cat("\nPolicy priority ranking:\n")
print(policy_df)
write_output_csv(policy_df, "policy_priority_by_sector.csv")

ggplot(policy_df, aes(x = reorder(sector, -priority_score), y = priority_score)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Policy Priority Score by Sector", x = "Sector", y = "Priority Score") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
save_plot("10_policy_priority_score.png")
```

scenario_df <- tibble(reduction_rate = scenario_rates) %>%
  mutate(
    avoided_tons_surplus = sum(summary$tons_surplus, na.rm = TRUE) * reduction_rate,

```{r sector-clustering}
cluster_cols <- c(
  "tons_surplus",
  "us_dollars_surplus",
  "surplus_total_100_year_mtco2e_footprint",
  "gallons_water_footprint"
)
cluster_cols <- c(cluster_cols, intersect(c("tons_landfill", "tons_donations"), names(detail)))
cluster_cols <- intersect(cluster_cols, names(detail))

cluster_features <- detail %>%
  group_by(sector) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(cluster_cols), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

X_cluster <- cluster_features %>%
  select(all_of(cluster_cols)) %>%
  scale()

n_clusters <- min(3, nrow(cluster_features))
hc <- hclust(dist(X_cluster), method = "ward.D2")
cluster_features <- cluster_features %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cutree(hc, k = n_clusters)))

cat("\nCluster assignments:\n")
print(cluster_features)

ggplot(cluster_features, aes(
  x = tons_surplus,
  y = surplus_total_100_year_mtco2e_footprint,
  color = cluster,
  label = sector
)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(nudge_x = 0.02 * max(cluster_features$tons_surplus, na.rm = TRUE), check_overlap = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Sector Clusters by Surplus and Emissions", x = "Tons of Surplus", y = "GHG Emissions (MTCO2e)", color = "Cluster") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r random-forest-regression}
regression_features <- intersect(
  c("tons_surplus", "gallons_water_footprint", "tons_landfill", "tons_composting", "tons_donations", "tons_animal_feed"),
  names(detail)
)

target_col <- "surplus_total_100_year_mtco2e_footprint"
reg_df <- detail %>%
  select(all_of(c(regression_features, target_col))) %>%
  drop_na()

if (!has_randomForest || !has_caret) {
  cat("Install the 'randomForest' and 'caret' packages to run this section.\n")
} else {
  library(randomForest)
  library(caret)

  train_index <- createDataPartition(reg_df[[target_col]], p = 0.80, list = FALSE)
  train_df <- reg_df[train_index, ]
  test_df  <- reg_df[-train_index, ]

  rf_formula <- as.formula(paste(target_col, "~", paste(regression_features, collapse = " + ")))
  rf_reg <- randomForest(rf_formula, data = train_df, ntree = 300, importance = TRUE)
  y_pred <- predict(rf_reg, newdata = test_df)
  y_test <- test_df[[target_col]]

  regression_metrics <- tibble(
    rmse = sqrt(mean((y_test - y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    r2 = cor(y_test, y_pred, use = "complete.obs")^2
  )

  cat("\nRandom forest regression metrics:\n")
  print(regression_metrics)

  feature_importance <- importance(rf_reg) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    arrange(desc(IncNodePurity))

  cat("\nRegression feature importances:\n")
  print(feature_importance)
  write_output_csv(feature_importance, "regression_feature_importance.csv")

  ggplot(feature_importance, aes(x = IncNodePurity, y = reorder(feature, IncNodePurity))) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(title = "Feature Importance for Predicting GHG Emissions", x = "Importance", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal()
  save_plot("13_regression_feature_importance.png", width = 8, height = 5)

  actual_predicted <- tibble(actual = y_test, predicted = as.numeric(y_pred))
  ggplot(actual_predicted, aes(x = actual, y = predicted)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
    labs(title = "Actual vs Predicted GHG Emissions", x = "Actual MTCO2e", y = "Predicted MTCO2e") +
    theme_minimal()
  save_plot("14_actual_vs_predicted_ghg.png", width = 7, height = 7)
}
```

```{r random-forest-classification}
clf_features <- intersect(c("tons_landfill", "tons_donations", "gallons_water_footprint", "tons_animal_feed", "tons_composting"), names(detail))
clf_df <- detail %>%
  select(all_of(c(clf_features, "tons_surplus"))) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(high_waste = factor(if_else(tons_surplus > median(tons_surplus, na.rm = TRUE), "high", "low")))

if (!has_randomForest || !has_caret) {
  cat("Install the 'randomForest' and 'caret' packages to run this section.\n")
} else {
  library(randomForest)
  library(caret)

  clf_index <- createDataPartition(clf_df$high_waste, p = 0.80, list = FALSE)
  clf_train <- clf_df[clf_index, ]
  clf_test  <- clf_df[-clf_index, ]

  clf_formula <- as.formula(paste("high_waste ~", paste(clf_features, collapse = " + ")))
  rf_clf <- randomForest(clf_formula, data = clf_train, ntree = 300, importance = TRUE)
  yc_pred <- predict(rf_clf, newdata = clf_test)

  classification_metrics <- tibble(accuracy = mean(yc_pred == clf_test$high_waste))
  cat("\nRandom forest classification metrics:\n")
  print(classification_metrics)
  print(confusionMatrix(yc_pred, clf_test$high_waste))

  clf_importance <- importance(rf_clf) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
    arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseGini))

  write_output_csv(clf_importance, "classification_feature_importance.csv")

  ggplot(clf_importance, aes(x = MeanDecreaseGini, y = reorder(feature, MeanDecreaseGini))) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(title = "Feature Importance for High-Waste Classification", x = "Importance", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal()
  save_plot("15_classification_feature_importance.png", width = 8, height = 5)
}
```

```{r network-analysis}
network_df <- detail %>%
  select(sector, food_category, tons_surplus) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  group_by(sector, food_category) %>%
  summarise(tons_surplus = sum(tons_surplus, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

if (!has_igraph) {
  cat("Install the 'igraph' package to run network centrality and plotting.\n")
} else {
  library(igraph)

  G <- graph_from_data_frame(network_df, directed = TRUE)
  centrality <- tibble(
    node = names(degree(G, mode = "all", normalized = TRUE)),
    degree_centrality = as.numeric(degree(G, mode = "all", normalized = TRUE))
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(degree_centrality))

  cat("\nTop network nodes by degree centrality:\n")
  print(head(centrality, 15))
  write_output_csv(centrality, "network_degree_centrality.csv")

  top_edges <- network_df %>% arrange(desc(tons_surplus)) %>% slice_head(n = 100)
  write_output_csv(top_edges, "top_sector_food_edges.csv")

  plot_edges <- network_df %>% arrange(desc(tons_surplus)) %>% slice_head(n = 25)
  G_plot <- graph_from_data_frame(plot_edges, directed = TRUE)

  if (has_ggraph) {
    library(ggraph)
    ggraph(G_plot, layout = "fr") +
      geom_edge_link(aes(width = tons_surplus), alpha = 0.6, arrow = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm")), end_cap = circle(3, "mm")) +
      geom_node_point(size = 5, alpha = 0.9) +
      geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, size = 3) +
      scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 4)) +
      labs(title = "Top Sector → Food Category Surplus Pathways") +
      theme_void()
    save_plot("17_network_top_pathways.png", width = 14, height = 10)
  } else {
    plot(G_plot, vertex.size = 8, vertex.label.cex = 0.7, edge.width = scales::rescale(E(G_plot)$tons_surplus, to = c(1, 8)), main = "Top Sector → Food Category Surplus Pathways")
  }
}
```

```{r optimization}
# Hypothetical intervention cost units by sector. Replace with real policy cost estimates if available.
optimization_df <- policy_df %>%
  mutate(
    intervention_cost = rep(c(3, 4, 2, 5, 3, 4, 2, 3, 4, 2), length.out = n()),
    emissions_benefit = surplus_total_100_year_mtco2e_footprint
  )

costs <- optimization_df$intervention_cost
benefits <- optimization_df$emissions_benefit
budget <- min(10, sum(costs, na.rm = TRUE))

if (has_lpSolve) {
  library(lpSolve)
  result <- lp(
    direction = "max",
    objective.in = benefits,
    const.mat = matrix(costs, nrow = 1),
    const.dir = "<=",
    const.rhs = budget,
    all.bin = TRUE
  )
  optimization_df <- optimization_df %>%
    mutate(optimal_allocation = if (result$status == 0) result$solution else 0)
} else {
  cat("Package 'lpSolve' is not installed. Using a greedy benefit-per-cost fallback.\n")
  optimization_df <- optimization_df %>%
    mutate(benefit_per_cost = emissions_benefit / intervention_cost) %>%
    arrange(desc(benefit_per_cost))

  remaining_budget <- budget
  allocation <- numeric(nrow(optimization_df))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(optimization_df))) {
    if (remaining_budget <= 0) break
    allocation[i] <- min(1, remaining_budget / optimization_df$intervention_cost[i])
    remaining_budget <- remaining_budget - allocation[i] * optimization_df$intervention_cost[i]
  }

  optimization_df <- optimization_df %>%
    mutate(optimal_allocation = allocation) %>%
    select(-benefit_per_cost)
}

optimization_df <- optimization_df %>% arrange(desc(optimal_allocation))

cat("\nOptimization results:\n")
print(optimization_df %>% select(sector, intervention_cost, emissions_benefit, optimal_allocation))
write_output_csv(optimization_df, "optimization_results.csv")

ggplot(optimization_df, aes(x = reorder(sector, -optimal_allocation), y = optimal_allocation)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Optimal Intervention Allocation by Sector", x = "Sector", y = "Allocation Share") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
save_plot("18_optimization_allocation.png")
```
